So improvements: Android World provides a testing environment, dynamic tasks, recycling tasks, networked tasks, etc. AITW does not have interactive environment, just dataset. So which option matches? Option B: "Android World has expanded the testing scope of AITW to include more difficult testing tasks that can be networked and vary with the environment." That seems plausible. Option C: "Android World provides an interactive testing environment that allows models to be tested during the exploration process." That also true. Option D: "Android World has a larger training and testing set." Not really: Android World is not a dataset; it's an environment. And it's not necessarily larger training/testing set; it has 116 tasks vs AITW's 700k episodes. So D is wrong. Option A: "Android World utilizes open-source models to train a more powerful open-source Android agent model." That is not correct; Android World is an environment, not a model. So correct answer is either B or C. The question: "The main differences and improvements between Android World and AITW are: A..., B..., C..., D...".
